description: AlertSpec defines an alerting rule for events involving a list of objects.

eventMetadata.description:
EventMetadata is an optional field for adding metadata to events dispatched by the
controller. This can be used for enhancing the context of the event. If a field
would override one already present on the original event as generated by the emitter,
then the override doesn't happen, i.e. the original value is preserved, and an info
log is printed.

eventSeverity.description:
EventSeverity specifies how to filter events based on severity.
If set to 'info' no events will be filtered.

additionalProperties.description:
CrossNamespaceObjectReference contains enough information to let you locate the
typed referenced object at cluster level

matchLabels.description:
MatchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels
map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the
operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.
MatchLabels requires the name to be set to `*`.

name.description:
Name of the referent
If multiple resources are targeted `*` may be set.

eventSources.description:
EventSources specifies how to filter events based
on the involved object kind, name and namespace.

exclusionList.description:
ExclusionList specifies a list of Golang regular expressions
to be used for excluding messages.

fullNameOverride.description: Replaces the entire computed resource name, ignoring the release name and id.

inclusionList.description:
InclusionList specifies a list of Golang regular expressions
to be used for including messages.

nameOverride.description: Replaces just the id part of the computed resource name (<Release.Name>-<id>).

namespace.description: metadata.namespace for this resource. Defaults to the release namespace.

providerRef.description: ProviderRef specifies which Provider this Alert should use.

summary.description:
Summary holds a short description of the impact and affected cluster.
Deprecated: Use EventMetadata instead.

suspend.description:
Suspend tells the controller to suspend subsequent
events handling for this Alert.
